title: Recovery time components
method: Synthetic sequential recovery stages. Restore time uses 180,000 MB divided by 150 MB/s and sixty seconds per minute. Sum all four stages for fifty minutes. Parallel work would require a critical-path calculation instead.
alt: Recovery time components: Decision and access 8 minutes, Restore data 20 minutes, Replay logs 12 minutes, Validate service 10 minutes. Illustrative inputs.
